headline: ETFs −$636M on Oct 22 (provisional), erasing the prior day's inflow; net realized profit hits a 334-day high.

findings.title: Profit taking spreads to all holders; coins above 84K go under water
findings.lean_why: Coins bought high are now at a loss and profit-taking supply persists, so a bounce into 82–86K meets break-even sellers; but this is not capitulation and doesn't turn the cycle bearish.
findings.what: CoinMetrics daily net realized P/L +$2.31B on Oct 22, 1-year percentile 99.5, the highest in 334 days (last 2025/11/22, +$8.00B); last 7 days +$4.07B vs +$0.95B the 7 days before. CheckOnChain STH realized profit 7,299 BTC (Oct 23, 98.1st percentile), slightly below Oct 22's 7,933 but still more than double 3,289 a week ago.
findings.why: Breaking it down: STH realized loss 1,819 BTC vs 2,005 a week ago, profit ÷ loss up from 1.64 to 4.01, so the profit side is what moved. CoinMetrics (all holders, net) and CheckOnChain (short-term holders) are independent and agree, two days running. Price didn't absorb it: the STH share in profit fell from 88.4% (Oct 21) to 56.18% (Oct 22, 30-day low), and the URPD 84–86K bucket holds about 1.185M BTC (Oct 22), coins bought high that are now under water; ETFs saw a provisional −$636M the same day. STH-SOPR 1.0199 (Oct 23) is still above 1, so sellers are on average still in profit.
findings.alt: ETF redemptions and exchange or custody wallet reshuffles also register as on-chain realization; the Oct 22 ETF outflow fell on the same day as the realized profit, so part may be the same coins. CheckOnChain data is smoothed; CoinMetrics lags ~1 day and is net only, not gross profit.
findings.history: Net realized P/L at or above the 98th percentile happened only twice in the past year (2026-08-21, 2026-09-21), with 30-day returns of +3.6% and −2.7% (n=2); the profit-into-drop combo fired 4 times, 30 days later −5.2% to +12.3% (n=4). Too few samples; background only.
findings.so: Potential supply above price at 82–86K has grown, so a short-term rally must first absorb break-even sellers; but SOPR holds above 1 and the 30-day cumulative net realized P/L is +0.70% of market cap — no capitulation. The market stage (bull day 15) and exit framework are unaffected.
findings.next: By Oct 30: a close below the true market mean at 79,375 means selling has overwhelmed buying (confirm); the STH share in profit back above 70% means the supply has been absorbed (refute).

findings.title: Three days of ETF inflows erased in one; US spot demand still absent
findings.lean_why: Three independent spot gauges are weak at once and price is propped up only by leveraged longs; demand lacks a sustained buyer.
findings.what: ETFs saw a provisional net −$635.6M on Oct 22 (The Block news −$635.6M, SoSoValue −$635.5M), the largest daily outflow since June; IBIT −$254.1M, FBTC −$217.5M, ARKB −$109.4M, and only MSBT of the 12 funds took in money. The prior three days (Oct 19–21) totaled +$1.08B (The Block).
findings.why: The signal rules have no single-day ETF item; this rests on ETF data and news. Breakdown: outflows were concentrated at the three largest issuers, not one fund. Cross-check: Coinbase premium −0.137% on Oct 23, 7-day avg −0.122%, 10.4th percentile of site records (n=299); stablecoin supply 7-day −0.64% (DefiLlama Oct 23); Fear & Greed 68 → 50. Three different sources all point to weak US spot. Derivatives disagree: weighted funding 10.08%, leveraged longs haven't left.
findings.alt: Single-day flows are often amplified by basis trades and market-maker rebalancing; the Nasdaq fell 2.6% on Oct 22, so it may just have been a cross-asset de-risking day. The provisional figure awaits The Block's data page, and Oct 23 flows aren't out yet.
findings.history: The site has no backtest of single-day ETF outflows; The Block calls it the largest daily outflow since June — background only. Seven complete trading days (Oct 13–21) total +$915M, still positive after Oct 22.
findings.so: Flows fell back from 'three days of strength' to day-by-day back-and-forth; ETFs have not built a sustained bid. Realized cap 30-day +1.17%, so the capital backdrop is still inflow. The market stage and exit framework are unaffected.
findings.next: By Oct 30: the Coinbase premium 7-day average back above 0, or stablecoin supply 7-day change turning positive, means spot demand is back (refute).

items.title: Fasanara Digital + Glassnode: Q4 2026 Institutional Market Perspectives
items.points: BTC regained its three main on-chain cost bases after the August short squeeze, which the report calls a mark of a healthy bull market; it recaps capital outflows and cycle-low volume and volatility after last October's top, and argues the data since August is more than short covering. No current key price level is given.
